description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.02 USDC per call via x402] From clock-in/clock-out entries per worker: hours worked (breaks removed, overnight shifts handled), optional punch rounding (e.g. to the nearest 15 minutes), regular / overtime / double-time hours under the rules you set (daily after N hours, double after M, weekly after 40, applied without counting an hour twice), and pay at each entry's rate. Per worker and per entry, with warnings for overlapping or very long shifts. Minutes are counted exactly; pay is rounded to cents once per worker. You choose the rules; not legal advice.

defaultRate.description: hourly rate when an entry has none

end.description: clock-out; earlier than start means the next day (overnight)

rate.description: hourly rate for this entry, e.g. "22.50"

dailyAfterHours.description: hours per day before overtime, e.g. 8 (California)

doubleAfterDailyHours.description: hours per day before double time, e.g. 12

weeklyAfterHours.description: hours per week before overtime, e.g. 40 (US federal)

roundPunchesTo.description: round each clock-in and clock-out to the nearest N minutes (ties round up)

weekStarts.description: first day of the pay week, default monday

name: timesheet_calc
title: Hours, overtime and pay from clock-in/out entries (exact)
